fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn. Uses one unified remote scene-anchor pipeline for physical furniture, free-standing and wall scenes, with synchronized participant alignment, scene controls and NPC undressing. v0.35.5 keeps the validated scene/transport/PPA behavior and adds a common OCum CumOverlays repair for both free and physical-furniture scenes: when a Body [OvlN] appears or persists into a new scene, OStim Together asks RaceMenu's public RevertOverlay API to relink that overlay to the actor's current body skin with resetDiffuse=false, then reapplies the OCum node properties. This avoids direct NiSkinInstance cloning and supersedes obsolete proxy hard-reinstall passes.
